source: atlas (found by the sweep in tests/geo/knifeEdge.test.ts)
note: 0.005 x 0.0175 deg = exactly 3.5 %, which half-even rounds UP to 4 — and unsnapped the raw sits just BELOW the half and rounds to 3. The error runs both ways, so the snap is not a one-sided fudge.

knife_edge.note: raw_pct_unsnapped is this clipper's value, for documentation — another implementation will land a few 1e-13 elsewhere. What both must agree on is pct_with_snap.
